open_points.subject: ProjectOverview progress availability
open_points.text: “A section without a record has no recorded progress: its views show `completion_percent = None` and `completed_work_value = None`” versus “`not_configured` means the portal has no owning data yet”
open_points.question: When an active budget has planned-work sections but no SectionProgress record exists for any section, does reading the overview return an available ProgressView containing null section values, or mark progress as `not_configured` and omit the ProgressView?
options: Return `progress_availability = available` with the active-budget sections, null per-section progress values, `overall_progress_percent = None`, and `completed_work_total = 0`.
Return `progress_availability = not_configured` with `progress = None`; nullable section values apply only when a ProgressView exists for some recorded progress or when read through BudgetView.
open_points.default_guess: Treat progress as `not_configured` until at least one SectionProgress record exists.

witness.initial: An active project has an active budget with one section whose `work_planned` is 100, and it has no SectionProgress records.
events: A viewer with an active grant opens ProjectOverview.
outcomes: The viewer receives an available ProgressView containing the section with `completion_percent = None`, `completed_work_value = None`, overall progress unavailable, and completed-work total zero.
The viewer receives `progress_availability = not_configured` and no ProgressView.
witness.observer: The viewer and any client rendering the overview.

open_points.subject: PaymentSummaryView completed work and work balance
open_points.text: “`completed_work_total` (here and in `BudgetView`) is the sum of the sections' `completed_work_value` that are not `None`” does not include `PaymentSummaryView`, although that DTO also requires `completed_work_total`, `work_balance`, and `balance_label`.
open_points.question: How does the payment-summary read behave when one or more planned-work sections have no SectionProgress record, especially when none has recorded progress: does it sum only known completed-work values and compute a balance, or make the payment summary unavailable because completed work is unrecorded?
options: Apply the same non-`None` sum to PaymentSummaryView, so no recorded progress yields `completed_work_total = 0` and a balance computed from zero.
Do not produce PaymentSummaryView until the required progress facts exist, representing the payment component as unavailable.
Use another explicitly defined missing-data rule for PaymentSummaryView and its balance.
open_points.default_guess: Apply the same non-`None` sum used by ProgressView and BudgetView, including an empty sum of zero.

witness.initial: An active project has a section with `work_planned = 100`, no SectionProgress record, and one received payment of 40.
events: A viewer reads the project overview and its payment component.
outcomes: PaymentSummaryView is available with `completed_work_total = 0`, `work_balance = -40`, and `balance_label = unused_advance_payment`.
The payment component is unavailable because its completed-work input is absent, so no work balance or label is returned.
witness.observer: The viewer, who either sees an unused advance of 40 or sees no payment summary.
